item.title: ‘Mississippi Made’ exhibit coming to Two Mississippi Museums on March 7
item.description: MISSISSIPPI (KTVE/KARD) -- Coming soon at Two Mississippi Museums, "Mississippi Made," a special exhibit highlighting people, industries, and creative traditions that have influenced the nation, will open March 7 and be on exhibit through Nov. 6.
